project.name: Defend the Crystal
project.camera_context: High oblique arena camera; the player moves around the center crystal and aims independently with the mouse.

asset.name: Prism Ranger
asset.purpose: Replace the procedural cyan player with an original generated hero and a simple walking loop without changing gameplay rules.

source.model_or_pack: Meshy 7 High Detail multi-image-to-3D, fixed-count remesh, 2K PBR texture, Humanoid rig, and Meshy locomotion clips
source.seed_or_task_id: Meshy web task IDs were not exposed in the downloaded archive

rights.attribution_required: not indicated by the selected Private option
rights.notes: The Meshy form showed Private selected while the account was on Pro. Current provider terms should be checked before public distribution.

technical.scale_units: Runtime-normalized to 1.8 Three.js world units tall

evidence: Approved turnaround and isolated front, back, and right views
Walking preview showed alternating legs and arm swing
No visible shoulder or knee breakage
GLTFLoader loaded the GLB over HTTP
Procedural fallback appeared when the GLB was temporarily unavailable

manual_wasd_animation.notes: The in-app browser control could not hold a movement key on the canvas. Alex should confirm the walking loop during normal WASD play.

decision.notes: The generated player, animation, controls ownership, build, restart, and fallback are integrated. Final V5 sign-off waits for Alex's normal WASD play check.
